thb.text: Klothys is the god who long ago volunteers as the eternal jailer of the titans sealed in the Underworld, and after the apotheosis of Xenagos she leaves the Underworld.
Livid that souls are escaping the Underworld, she weaves the Agent of Fate Calix to pursue Elspeth and sends agents after defiers of fate, in the confrontation of which Niko's spark ignites.
Klothys sets out to mend the destiny of Theros, her fury guiding every stitch, and she traps Heliod in the Underworld as punishment for his hubris.
